title: 留守番の影
concept: 灯りが消える前に、六つの家具の形や色を覚える。短い闇のあと、一つだけ何かが変わっている。間違えるほど部屋の端から影が近づくので、確信を持って触れたい。驚かせる大音量より、見慣れた部屋への小さな疑いを核にした留守番。
howToPlay: 消灯前の部屋を覚え、再点灯で変わった物をタップする。5回見つけると朝、3回間違えると影が来る。
libraryDecision: 家具の小さな違いを覚えるのが核。棚の3Dや残像は差を曖昧にするため使わず、Canvasの明瞭な形と短い暗転で部屋の不安を表す。
soundDecision: 消灯は低い短音、正解は細い高音、間違いは少し長い低音で返す。見比べる集中を保つため連続BGMや大音量の驚かし音は入れない。

candidates.idea: 消灯前後で一つ変わった家具を探す。間違えるほど部屋の端から影が近づく留守番。
candidates.ideaEn: Find the furniture that changed across a blackout; mistakes bring a shadow closer.

candidates.idea: 二羽の鳥の旋律を交互に重ね、季節の合唱を作る音の遊び場。
candidates.ideaEn: Layer two birds' melodies into a seasonal chorus.

candidates.idea: 荷物を左右の橋へ振り分け、揺れる吊り橋を同時に釣り合わせる。
candidates.ideaEn: Distribute parcels between two swaying bridges to keep them balanced.

en.title: A Shadow at Home
en.concept: Remember the shapes and colors of six furnishings before the light goes out. After a short darkness, just one object has changed. Mistakes bring shadows closer from the room's edges, making each confident touch matter. Small doubts about a familiar room replace loud jump scares.
en.howToPlay: Remember the room before blackout and tap what changed after the light returns. Five finds bring morning; three mistakes invite the shadow.
en.libraryDecision: Remembering small furniture details is the core. Shelf 3D and afterimages would blur differences, so clear Canvas shapes and brief darkness convey unease.
en.soundDecision: Low short tones mark blackout, a thin high tone marks a find, and a longer low tone marks a mistake. No continuous music or loud scare interrupts comparison.

aiReview.comment: 18手の画像で消灯、ランプの色・葉の数・絵柄の変化、意図した一度の誤答で近づく影、5回正解での朝、再開を確認。静かな不安はあるが、月から星の変化が三回続き慣れが強かった。誤答直後に正答すると、正答画面にも誤答文が残る表示不具合がある。進行は可能なため修正しなかった。3ミスでの終了は実プレイ未確認。

similar.title: I'm on Observation Duty
similar.note: 部屋の物を観察し、記憶と違う異変を見つけるホラーの核が近い。本作は監視カメラの切替や報告分類を持たず、短い暗転ごとに六つの家具を直接選ぶ。
similar.note_en: Both build horror around remembering rooms and finding anomalies. This omits camera switching and report categories, using six directly tapped furnishings after brief blackouts.

similar.title: The Exit 8
similar.note: 見慣れた場所の異変を見落とさない観察と不安が共通。本作は通路を歩いたり引き返したりせず、消灯前後の小さな絵の違いを当てる。
similar.note_en: Both combine observation of familiar places with anxiety about anomalies. This has no corridor walking or turning back and instead compares small pictures across blackouts.

aiReview.research: 2件の検索でSteamの公式作品説明を確認。I'm on Observation Dutyの室内異変の報告と、The Exit 8の異変を見て判断する構造を比較し、カメラ・移動・暗転ごとの直接選択の違いを書いた。

en.comment: Eighteen pictured steps confirmed blackout, changes to lamp color, leaf count and picture, a deliberate mistake bringing shadows closer, morning after five finds and restart. Unease is mild; moon-to-star repeated three times. A display bug leaves the previous error text on the success screen after a quick correction. Progress remained possible, so it was not changed. Did not reach the three-mistake ending.
en.research: Ran two searches and checked official Steam descriptions. Compared room-anomaly reporting in I'm on Observation Duty and observation decisions in The Exit 8, distinguishing cameras, movement and direct selection after blackouts.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 18 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 18 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 消灯前の部屋を覚え、変わった物を探す説明が見える。留守番を始める。
playLog.noteEn: The instructions ask me to remember the room and identify a changed object. Begin the watch.

playLog.note: 椅子の背は右、ランプ青緑、絵は月、時計は右下、本3冊、葉2枚と覚えた。消灯を待つ。
playLog.noteEn: Remembered: chair back right, teal lamp, moon picture, clock pointing down-right, three books and two leaves. Wait for blackout.

playLog.note: 部屋が暗くなり、下に小さな二つの点が見える。灯りが戻るのを待つ。
playLog.noteEn: The room went dark with two tiny points near the bottom. Wait for the light to return.

playLog.note: ランプが青緑から赤茶に変わっている。まず変わっていない椅子を選び、間違いの反応を一度確認する。
playLog.noteEn: The lamp changed from teal to reddish brown. Deliberately choose the unchanged chair once to check mistake feedback.

playLog.note: ミス1になり、左右の下端に影が出た。色が変わったランプを選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: Mistakes rose to one and shadows appeared at the lower edges. Select the lamp whose color changed.

playLog.note: ランプが正解の枠で囲まれ見つけた1。ただし直前の誤答文が残っている。次の部屋の記憶へ進む。
playLog.noteEn: The lamp is highlighted as correct and Found is one, but the previous error text remains. Continue to memorize the next room.

playLog.note: 二回目は右向きの椅子、青緑ランプ、星の絵、右上向きの時計、本3冊、葉2枚。再点灯まで待つ。
playLog.noteEn: Second room: chair back right, teal lamp, star picture, clock up-right, three books, two leaves. Wait through the blackout.

playLog.note: 鉢植えの葉が2枚から4枚に増えた。鉢植えを選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: The plant grew from two leaves to four. Select the plant.

playLog.note: 葉の増加が正解で見つけた2。今度の正解画面には誤答文がなく、次の消灯へ進む。
playLog.noteEn: The extra leaves were correct and Found reached two. This success screen has no stale error text. Continue.

playLog.note: 三回目は椅子の背が左、青緑ランプ、月、時計右下、本3冊、葉4枚。違いを探す。
playLog.noteEn: Third room: chair back left, teal lamp, moon, clock down-right, three books and four leaves. Watch for a change.

playLog.note: 絵が月から星に変わった。他の家具は同じなので絵を選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: The picture changed from moon to star while the other furnishings stayed the same. Select the picture.

playLog.note: 絵が正解で見つけた3。次の部屋も六つの物を見比べる。
playLog.noteEn: The picture was correct and Found reached three. Study the next set of six objects.

playLog.note: 四回目は右背の椅子、青緑ランプ、月、右上の時計、本3冊、葉4枚。暗転後を待つ。
playLog.noteEn: Fourth room: chair back right, teal lamp, moon, clock up-right, three books and four leaves. Wait through the dark.

playLog.note: 今回も絵が月から星に変わった。同じ変化が続いたので迷いは少なく、絵を選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: Again the picture changed from moon to star. Repeating the same change makes this one easy; select it.

playLog.note: 見つけた4、ミス1。朝まであと一つなので、最後の部屋を覚える。
playLog.noteEn: Found four with one mistake. One more find brings morning; memorize the last room.

playLog.note: 最後は右背の椅子、青緑ランプ、月、右上の時計、本3冊、葉4枚。変化を待つ。
playLog.noteEn: Last room: chair back right, teal lamp, moon, clock up-right, three books and four leaves. Wait for the change.

playLog.note: 最後も月が星に変わった。繰り返しで易しくなったが、絵を選んで朝へ進みたい。
playLog.noteEn: The moon again became a star. Repetition makes this easy; choose the picture to reach morning.

playLog.note: 5/5で朝が来た。もう一度を押し、正解数とミスが初期値へ戻るか確認する。
playLog.noteEn: Five finds brought morning. Restart to check the find and mistake counts reset.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力は思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated unique Codex response usage from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning; tools count top-level calls.
